title_ru: ВХОД — ТЕПЛОЗАЩИТА И ВХОД В АТМОСФЕРУ
description: An interactive field guide to atmospheric entry: Allen and Eggers' discovery that peak deceleration depends only on entry speed and angle, why Apollo needed lift to turn 36 g into 6.6 g, stagnation-point heating and why blunt capsules survive, ablative heat shields from Stardust's record 12.9 km/s entry to Orion's Artemis I char loss and the Artemis II fix.
og: Peak g independent of mass, 36 g vs 6.6 g for Apollo, and why blunt is better — atmospheric entry, interactive and sourced from NASA.
